layout_concept: Four-page A4 landscape sequence on a 12-column grid, pacing hero -> argument -> evidence -> panorama. Cover: wide hero photo (8 cols) with a large serif title beneath and a narrow keyword column. Concept: text column left, tall portrait image dominant in the centre, square image and site note on the right, tops aligned. Drawing: the plan is the dominant 10-column plate with a narrow caption column. Closing: full-width panorama above a single italic statement.
principles: spend boldness in one place: the cover title and the plan plate
drawings and photos keep exact aspect, never cropped
one accent colour used only for short rules and section labels
white space carries the pacing; no decorative cards or numbering
generic_defaults_checked: cream+serif+terracotta: replaced with white paper and a deep teal accent
identical cards: each page has a different structure
all-caps eyebrow labels: labels are lower-case serif italic
numbered markers without a real sequence: none used
